name: hard-won-skills
description: Hard-won habits for Claude Code, grouped by theme — install only the themes you work in.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Branch, worktree and pull-request hygiene: rebasing open PRs onto a merged base, replying to review findings, pruning dead branches, embedding screenshots that actually render, posting coverage as one sticky comment with a threshold band, and checking a diagram still matches the system, waiting out a PR's checks without misreading silence as success, and fanning a batch of independent fixes out to parallel agents as file-disjoint PRs.

plugins.name: agent-config
plugins.description: Authoring and auditing agent instruction files. Find contradictions and duplication across a CLAUDE.md stack, keep a config file a pointer instead of a copy, spot rules worth turning into a skill, and capture a long session's learnings before compacting it.

plugins.name: verification
plugins.description: Evidence discipline: prove a test, assertion or CI gate can actually fail before trusting it, and observe a dependency's real behaviour instead of asserting what its docs imply.

plugins.name: data-safety
plugins.description: Guardrails for writes that are hard to undo. Probe a migration inside a transaction and roll it back, make a bulk write reversible before running it, and catch the Supabase-managed-schema traps that pass review and fail in production.

plugins.name: mobile-ui
plugins.description: Android and Compose UI work: recording and verifying screenshot baselines without the silent no-op that reports PASSED while comparing nothing, building a Compose component from a Figma node bound to design tokens, and verifying a change on a running device without reading a stale frame.
